director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket pitch jaise number line par fractions rakhenge. Cricket mein tumhe kya pasand hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Aaj hum fractions ko ek seedhi line par jagah denge. Cricket ki pitch socho. Ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman run lene bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, toh us jagah ka bhi ek number hai.
haan samajh gayi
Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: near 3

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Achha, ise ek baar aise sochte hain. Ghar 0 par, chai ki dukaan 1 kilometre par, aur line ke upar sadak 7 barabar gaps mein bati hai. Ek chaabi wala khilona pehle mark par ruka. Woh sadak ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, uska number 1/7 kilometre hai. Yahan tak saaf hai?

seams.form: Achha, ise ek baar aise sochte hain.

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Bilkul, ab yeh Hindi mein bolti hoon. Chaabi wala khilona hawa mein nahi, sadak ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai. Us jagah ka bhi number hai, 1/7 kilometre. Line ke neeche wahi sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Line ke neeche wahi sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: 1 and 6
Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Line ke neeche bhi wahi sadak hai, bas 6 barabar gaps mein. Ek gap poore kilometre ka kaunsa fraction hai, yahi socho. Woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Line ke neeche wahi sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: one sixth km

Bilkul sahi, kyunki line ke neeche sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehla mark 0 se ek gap par, yaani 1/6 kilometre. Ab us sawaal par lautte hain jo humne pehle chhoda tha. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

seams.form: Ab us sawaal par lautte hain jo humne pehle chhoda tha.

director.text: drawing karke samjhao

Yahan do barabar lambi pattiyaan hain: upar wali do barabar hisson mein, ek hissa rangin, aur neeche wali teen barabar hisson mein, abhi bina rang ke. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: near 3
Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Is sawaal ka sahi jawab: isi line par, kyunki neeche wala number 3 matlab 0 se 1 ke 3 barabar gaps, aur pehla gap isi line par khatam hota hai. Yahan tak saaf hai?
pata nahi, aap batao
1/3 poore 1 se chhota hai, toh woh 0 aur 1 ke beech hi aata hai, 3 ke paas kabhi nahi. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
mujhe nahi pata

Wahi 0 se 1 ki line, par ab line ke upar 6 marks hain. Marks mat gino, gaps gino: 7 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark hai 1/7. Ab line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?
director.card: Ab line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: Ab line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

director.text: 7 sahi nahi hai. Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Darzi ka ribbon socho, 0 se 1 metre. Line ke upar 6 chalk ke marks hain, aur ribbon ke 7 barabar gap. Pehla mark pehle gap ke end par hai, yaani 1/7 metre. Naam gap ginkar milta hai, marks ginkar nahi. Ab tak samajh aaya?

seams.form: Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara
Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh number line wala kaam khatam ho jaaye. Ribbon par line ke neeche pehla chalk mark 1/12 metre par hai. Line ke neeche kitne chalk ke marks hain?
director.card: Ribbon par line ke neeche pehla chalk mark 1/12 metre par hai. Line ke neeche kitne chalk ke marks hain?

director.text: 12 nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. Line ke neeche wale gap socho: marks gap ke beech hote hain, isliye marks hamesha gap se ek kam. Pehla chalk mark 1/12 metre par ho, toh ribbon par line ke neeche kitne chalk ke marks hain?
director.card: Ribbon par line ke neeche pehla chalk mark 1/12 metre par hai. Line ke neeche kitne chalk ke marks hain?

director.text: pata nahi
Is sawaal ka jawab 11 hai, kyunki 1/12 metre matlab ribbon ke 12 barabar gap, aur 12 gap ke beech 11 marks hote hain. Cricket mein tumhe kya karna sabse achha lagta hai?
bowling karna

Achha, toh tumhara favourite hai bowling karna. Ab wahin se aage badhte hain jahan ruke the. Ab line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?
director.card: Ab line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

seams.form: Ab wahin se aage badhte hain jahan ruke the.

j2.line: Achha, toh tumhara favourite hai bowling karna.

director.text: 8 barabar gaps

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada, toh 7 marks ke 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Pehle 7 gaps the, ab zyada hain, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, aur woh 0 ke bahut paas hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan, samajh aaya
Line ke neeche wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
director.card: Line ke neeche wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: ek bata das

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 10 gaps wala har gap 8 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par khade hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre door hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Pehla kadam dekho. Ek line kheencho, ghar 0 par aur school 1 par: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki ghar se school tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yeh kadam samajh aaya?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe mat gino, unke beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe hain, toh ginti 4 aayi, kyunki beech mein jitne marks hon, gaps hamesha usse ek zyada.
haan samajh gayi
Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se bas ek gap door hai. Woh kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se bas ek gap door hai. Woh kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: 1/4 km

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, 4 barabar gaps mein har gap 1/4 kilometre ka hai, aur pehla khamba 0 se theek ek gap par khada hai. Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 kilometre door hai. Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, barabar doori par. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, barabar doori par. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 1/10 sahi nahi hai. Marks chhodo, gaps gino. 0 se 1 ki line par 10 marks se jitne gaps bane, wahi neeche wala number hai. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, barabar doori par. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 1/11 hai na

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 10 marks se line ke 11 barabar gaps bante hain, aur pehla mark ek gap par hai, yaani 1/11. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/11 line par 1/4 ke baad aata hai, kyunki 11, 4 se bada hai. Zoya sahi hai ya galat?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/11 line par 1/4 ke baad aata hai, kyunki 11, 4 se bada hai. Zoya sahi hai ya galat?

director.text: sahi nahi

Sahi jawab. Dekho, wahi poora 11 mein bata toh har gap chhota, isliye 1/11 pehle rukta hai, 1/4 se pehle; Zoya galat hai. Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?
director.card: Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?

director.text: first
Haan, sahi hai: 1/9 matlab 9 barabar gaps mein se 1 gap, toh 1/9 ki jagah 0 se ek gap par, pehle mark par hai. Ab 0 se ek se zyada gap chalenge, aur fraction ka upar wala number batayega kitne.
thak gayi, bye
Theek hai Riya, thak gayi ho toh ruk sakti ho. Chuno: aage badhein, thoda pause lein, ya aaj ke liye rok dein?
